collection: Spring-type shock absorber: original CATIA assembly, valid STEP and static FEM plots
license: No explicit data license located; local research only.
limits: STEP imports as a valid 12-solid, 207-face assembly. Original CATIA definitions and products retained; STEP-to-native configuration and final FEM mesh mapping are pending.
WBPJ is an index, not a solved archive: referenced SYS-6/SYS-10 SCDOC and MECHDB files are absent. Source read-me says project folder omitted due size.
Force/pressure, fixed-face scopes, exact materials, contact behavior and convergence are not numerically documented in retained files. Plot extrema alone cannot define a reproducible grading task.
README claims modal and PSD random-vibration work, but no frequencies, PSD inputs or numerical outputs are uploaded. Count only the displayed static stress/deformation candidate.
Time label 1 s is a static load-step label; it is not a damping or impact trajectory. Complex CAD does not establish simulated hydraulic damping.
